features.name: counter_sentence_length_sd
features.definition: What is the standard deviation of sentence lengths (in words) across all sentences in the counter-argument comments?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings; malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> null (no sentences). Concatenate sentences from all comments (pooling sentences across comments; do not average per-comment). Split each comment into sentences with regex split on (?<=[.!?])\s+ and newlines, drop empty segments. Sentence length = count of tokens matching \b\w+\b (apostrophes kept within words via [\w']+). Return population standard deviation (ddof=0) of lengths across all sentences; if fewer than 2 sentences, return 0 if exactly one sentence, null if none.

h0: counter_sentence_length_sd has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Greater counter_sentence_length_sd is associated with a higher probability that the OP changed their view.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as delta (OP view change). Variation operationalized as pooled sentence-length SD in words across all counter-comments, with regex sentence splitting (imprecise for abbreviations, lists, quotes, URLs). SD is correlated with overall comment length and number of sentences; no controls added. Raw text may include quoted text or outcome announcements; not filtered. Comment order/timing unknown. Association only.
